name: Akaku Kagayaku Yuki
source:
Main character returns to snowy hometown after 15 years. There he finds nostalgic spots and reunites with two important childhood friends. He thinks that such happy quiet life will last forever, but there are traces of separation in the air.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角时隔15年重返冰雪故乡。在那里，他找到了怀旧的地方，并与两个重要的儿时好友重聚。他以为这样幸福平静的生活会永远持续下去，但空气中却弥漫着分离的痕迹。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
